products.deliveryType: Digital membership / online course and optional API service
products.descriptionEN: GainFlow Starter grants personal access to the GainFlow digital members area, including the Reels Viral Academy (lessons on hooks, scripting, recording, editing, distribution, analytics and a 30-day content plan) and access to an online tool to request a limited daily follower allocation for a profile controlled by the buyer, subject to technical availability and provider rules. The initial daily allocation is 10 followers, with a configured maximum of 15; delivery depends on provider support and verification. The buyer receives login instructions by email after approval of their purchase, and can request a refund within seven calendar days. General-public digital product; no Instagram password is requested. This is an independent service not affiliated with Meta or Instagram.

upsells.descriptionEN: Digital course and checklist on account security, 2FA, recovery codes, scam prevention and profile access hygiene. Educational material only; does not prevent platform enforcement. Delivered inside the digital members area after approved payment. Seven-day guarantee; support: flowinsta@outlook.com.

Condensed digital security checklist and basic guided setup for 2FA, privacy and account-recovery preparation. Includes fewer resources than the full Account Safety Academy. Delivered inside the digital members area after approved payment. Seven-day guarantee; support: flowinsta@outlook.com.

Digital educational toolkit and checklists about proving control of your own profile and understanding platform verification procedures. Not an official badge or identity verification by Instagram. Delivered inside the digital members area after approved payment. Seven-day guarantee; support: flowinsta@outlook.com.

Digital training on phishing defense, moderation policies, privacy, backup and account-recovery planning, including templates and operational checklists. Does not guarantee account safety or immunity from platform action. Delivered inside the digital members area after approved payment. Seven-day guarantee; support: flowinsta@outlook.com.

Digital training and 30-day tracking templates to monitor audience quality, follower changes, content consistency and retention metrics. Does not guarantee retention or prevent follower removal. Delivered inside the digital members area after approved payment. Seven-day guarantee; support: flowinsta@outlook.com.
